contracts.source: Cisco press release: Cisco Expands Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA for the (08-25-2026)
contracts.signal: Cisco announced a partnership under which it will offer Supermicro liquid- and air-cooled rack-scale and dense GPU systems, validated and sold as part of the Cisco AI infrastructure portfolio within the Cisco Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, beginning in October 2026. Supported platforms include NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8, with rack-to-fabric liquid cooling pairing Cisco liquid-cooled AI networking systems with Supermicro liquid-cooled servers. The expanded offer is an NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) compliant architecture for neocloud and sovereign cloud customers, using Cisco Silicon One-based front-end switches and Cisco's NVIDIA Spectrum-X based back-end switches; Cisco says it is the only NVIDIA technology partner using its own switches and network operating system in an NCP compliant solution (company claim).
contracts.units: Supermicro compute solutions offered beginning in October 2026; NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and HGX Rubin NVL8 platforms
